en.text: They took out the Pigeon Lady!
They won't be too happy about that.
They took out the Chess Guy!
Alright, that was pretty good, Paradox.
They are gonna be pissed about that…
They took out the Test Pilot!
Thought I was in trouble for a minute…
They took out the golden boy.
Maybe she's not as bad as I thought…
Not bad for a corporate stooge.
My mentor was right about him…
How did he learn how to do that…
I'd hate to have the OSIC hunting me…
Watching a Sandman work is scarier than I expected.
That could have been bad if Haze wasn't here…
Infernus and I took the objective.
That mole is beating the hell out of 'em.
The old man still has it.
Grey Talon was looking out for us.
They took out the Rat King!
You know what you're doing, Ivy.
He stood up to them all…
She wouldn't stop until they were dead…
Can't forget to upgrade my abilities.
I'm all alone in enemy territory, what can go wrong…
I might be pushing my luck staying out here…
I can't tell if I'm being overconfident or appropriately confident.
That could have went real bad…
I'm not ready to join the dead quite yet…
This is coming together well, isn't it?
This part always creeps me out…
The dead will have their due…
I'll dig them a shallow grave.
I won't let them kill me.
That should buy me a little time..
You'd think the Sheriff would have better things to do than hassle me.
Someone stop this guy from healing!
You're making this too easy, Bebop.
Come on, Bebop, at least make this a challenge.
Shouldn't have just stood there, Bebop.
That’s the only trick you got, Paradox?
Look out for a black hole.
Don't get close to the Professor.
How many of these damn things does she have?
I'm getting real tired of seeing these things.
We need to prepare our defenses.
They have the Rejuv, they're going to make a push.
Lady Geist is on the prowl.
You can't hide from the dead.
You're not as smart as you think, Haze.
You weren't safe up there, Vindicta…
You didn't actually think you were safe, did you?
Infernus has gotta be pissed about that…
Get this mole off of me!
You picked on the wrong girl.
Where the hell did they go?
Damn it, they were right here.
Shouldn't have gotten in my way.
I promised I'd do whatever it takes.
Today is definitely taking a turn.
I think I may be in over my head.
Oh you'll be back, don't cry about it.
I can't let you get in my way.
What the hell have I gotten myself into…
Oh god, the law's after me, that's great…
Shouldn't you be tracking down a serial killer or something, not worrying about a high school kid?
My mentor says she needs that tome.
You are messing with forces you don't understand, Abrams.
I'm not getting pushed around by a scrap golem.
Go back to the junk yard where you belong.
You'll have to find another way to help your mom.
You were never going to beat me BeBop.
She is way too positive for me.
How can she be so naïve?
Probably not welcome at the next pop-up museum, am I?
You're not bad, Paradox, but not bad's not enough.
A shame we couldn't work things out, Paradox.
I really want to like her but she's making it hard.
I don't know what the hell that thing was but it wasn't a doorman.
He thinks he's smarter than he is.
Drifter won't be hunting us any time soon.
That guy gave me the creeps.
It looks like my mastery of the dead extends to vampires.
I'm not going to be one of your victims, Drifter.
I don't like fighting teachers, it makes me feel weird.
I bet he is a better teacher than he is a fighter.
I gotta say, Dynamo, a lot of your former students are big fans.
If it makes you feel better I think your jacket's cool.
I wish I could make him a pet.
I'm gonna feel bad about that for a while.
Great I killed my lab partner.
I don't hate him as much as I wish I did.
He'll go cry to daddy and be fine, boo hoo.
This is gonna make class awkward next week.
Looks like you're not the best at everything after all.
Don't worry, McGinnis, the Fairfax war machine will roll on just fine without you.
You don't use magic, McGinnis, you abuse it.
The old ways are the strong ways, McGinnis.
I mean you’re a pile of dead bodies of course the necromancer was going to win.
You should have came to me for help, Victor.
Too bad, he was kinda cool.
At least I stopped his pain.
The dead can be so pushy sometimes.
She looks real good for her age.
I hate people like you, Geist.
You're not feeding me to Oathkeeper.
You were a fool to make a deal with Oathkeeper, Geist.
I wonder if he takes interns.
It takes a little more than lightning to scare me, Seven.
Your pursuit of power ends here, Seven.
So that's the guy who escaped Lost Whisper.
He won't be down for long.
I want the OSIC out of my business.
You should meet my mentor, Haze, I'd think you'd like her.
Doesn't the government have better things to do than bother teenagers?
Billy was right, the OSIC sucks.
I go to Blackmore, you think money impresses me?
I'm sorry about what happened to you, Vindicta.
I wish you'd let me help you, Vindicta.
I wasn't about to let you put more blood on your hands, Vindicta.
You didn't give me a choice, Vindicta.
For God's sake Infernus, stop trying to light me on fire!
I know what you did Infernus.
The people who worked at Pier 31 don't have kind things to say about you, Infernus.
I read a lot about him, he seemed cool.
I wish I wasn't fighting him, I have a million questions.
I bet my mentor would love to get her hands on that stone.
I might be able to help you, Kelvin, not today obviously because I killed you, but in the future.
I'm not getting mauled by a mole and his weird roommate.
At least Mo will be comfortable in the dirt.
I'm not intimidated by you, Lash.
He's like all the boys in my sophomore gym class merged together to form some super prick.
You got some nice tricks, Sinclair.
He seemed like a decent guy.
When this is over I'd love to keep in touch.
She's as dangerous as they say…
Glad I'm walking away from that in one piece.
You're not going to stop me, Grey Talon.
My mentor warned me about you, Talon.
I won't let you stop me, Venator.
Billy is such a pain in the ass.
I can't believe you're fighting for them, Billy.
You're being such a loser, Billy.
You're not pushing me around, Shiv.
He thought he was so cool.
You took something that doesn't belong to you, Shiv.
Once a Fairfax, always a Fairfax.
Feel kind of bad about fighting her.
Wish we were on the same side, Ivy.
That should get the gargoyle off our backs for a little bit.
Maybe you should have stuck with the circus.
You're out of your league, Celeste.
This was never going to end well for you Celeste.
You won life, Mina, can you stop being an asshole?
If the cops won't deal with you, I will.
You're not taking this hand, Vyper.
Get away from me, you scumbag.
That was a weird little goo guy.
I'd feel worse about that if he didn't get goo on me.
The cube was never going to be enough to protect you.
I can't let you stop me, Silver.
That could have gone real bad…
Lucky I'm walking away from that fight alive.
Glad I still have all three of my hands…
I bet she's fun to hang out with.
I really don't want Wraith as an enemy.
She's a bitch, but I'm kind of ok with it.
I get that I'm supposed to not like her but I can't help it.
I will make this up to you, Yamato, please don't take it personally.
Your lives are offered as tribute to my mentor.
The demands of the dead will be ignored no longer!
My mentor thanks you for throwing away your lives.
I can feel my power growing.
It just keeps getting easier and easier.
You can't stop an advocate of the dead.
The more they die, the stronger I become…
The dead are stirring in Midtown.
The bodies just keep piling up.
You don't have what it takes to stop me.
I bet the kids at Blackmore are gonna talk a lot less shit now.
Keep it together, Graves, you can do this.
Ok, it's all on me, no pressure there.
It's time to finish the ritual.
The time has come to summon the Patron.
I need to get back to my team.
I'll be back when I can.
Well stick with me, I'll take care of you.
You gonna go make daddy proud?
Don't talk to me like you know me.
I was skipping class. I'm fine.
How is someone kind of a warlord?
I mean we do. It's warlord.
I can take care of myself
And I'm hoping you get shot.
Nervous is what I get before finals, this is something a little different.
You kiddin' me? These guys are trying to kill us, I'm going to take all the protection I can get.
I'll try not to be offended.
Can you get off my back you little robo-hypocrite?
Look, the dead aren't very bright…if any of them get in the way, I'm sorry.
Well whoever that is, they're cooler than you.
Why are you carrying so many books.
No I think it's none of your business, so how about you leave me alone. Thanks.
You work at Little Alexandria right?
Why does your necromancy section suck so much?
I've been to some of your pop-ups, they were pretty cool
The one two years ago was great.
Well, then someone from Paradox is going to wish they hadn't.
I'm not profiting off of innocent people.
My mentor, she… she likes you.
I spend half my free time in graveyards.
Please don't give me an inspiring teacher talk on my potential.
This seemed a little more important.
I kinda just want to focus on necromancy right now.
Are you a friend of my parents?
You think you're real clever, don't you.
What's it like being a corporate shill?
And all you had to do was sell your soul.
Are you related to Johann Geist?
He was really talented. I wrote a paper about him in humanities.
The jacket kinda gives it away.
You know your arm's evil, right?
Like, he won't stop screaming about what he wants to do to people.
What, or I'll end up like you?
Don't pretend like you care if I live or die.
You don't know what you're talking about.
I'm able to hold my own.
Right now I'm worried about living long enough to graduate.
Not interested in being a sandman.
Surprised you're not trying to take the hand.
So you were alive in the 1600s, huh?
Bet that was a shitty time to be a woman.
You know, helping the dead is kind of my thing, so if after the ritual you need anything…
Is it true you once kicked Mina Ha out of your bar?
Surprised she didn’t just bribe you.
God I would have loved to see her face.
Ya know there's rumors about you.
Yeah. Supposedly you're with the mob.
That's not what my classmates say.
Nice to meet you Mo, I'm Darcy.
I mean it was buried in lead box, its not like it was left on a random bench.
Why are you such a dick?
No I've seen you before, and not on the news.
Nono, they're alive - I know: you were at their Christmas party last year.
It was at Whiteside and Graves
Yeah. You gonna give me a lecture on how it's a bad idea to carry it?
Look, I think she's great - but objectively she's ugly as sin.
Not sure how useful that is during a firefight.
Do you have any idea how many people told me it's a bad idea?
Oh, like you're some kind of expert.
Believe me father, I already regret meeting you.
What kind of priest carries a gun
One that - ugh I don't do purple prose. I do. I traffic with the dead. If you have a problem with that you shouldn't be here.
Oh my god, someone religious is being closed minded I wish I wore pearls so I could clutch them.
Thanks for your concern. I can take things from here.
Way to go Billy, you got me all figured out. Truly you are the master of the human condition.
Yeah, they uh… they really are.
Mr. and Mrs. Romero are grateful for what you did for them.
They know it wasn't your fault. They're just grateful that you caught the ones responsible
I have the day off. Shouldn't you be jail.
Doesn't matter cause I'm not giving it to you.
Are you always a bitch, or is this something special just for me?
I think I don't hate you.
I'd say that humans are generally awful with moments of surprising compassion and that we all would probably be better off if 90% of us were replaced by cats.
You always want to be a bounty hunter?
It's not. The dead have people speaking to them all the time, go to a cemetery on Father's day and you can't throw a rock without hitting someone talking to a headstone.
You don't get it. It's not sweet for them. It's painful. They see loved ones hurting and they want to offer comfort, or advice, or… anything. To be their voice… it's...it's an honor.
Oh. Yeah, I can do that.
You know I've talked to a lot of people you've killed.
People who are dead because of you
The point is that they all say the same thing: None of them are mad at you. I don't understand why.
My parents have penthouse in midtown, what do you think?
Your jacket would be cooler without the fringe.
Don’t see that changing anytime soon.
You shouldn't have tried to fight me.
They won't be lucky next time.
Yeah, I'm not taking them on.
There's way too many of them.
If I see souls lying around I'm going to take them.
Hey man, I'll take all the souls I can.
If they're gonna drop it, I'm gonna take it.
Now's our chance to press the advantage.
I didn't forget what you did.
Might want to get those souls.
Graveyards aren't quiet. They're loud. Sometimes it's overwhelming, but if you stop and listen, the dead can tell one hell of a story.
Great, I'm running around Manhattan with a severed lich hand. How did this become my life?
The dead have been making a whole lot of demands lately.
This should make my mentor happy.
Completing some eldritch ritual beats finishing my paper on Wuthering Heights.
Yeah, like I'd miss my chance to summon a god.
Well today is about to get a whole lot more interesting.
You think I would miss out on the Maelstrom? I can't wait to get out there.
Well, my teachers are always asking me to apply myself so might as well do this.
I might want to swing by the store.
Wonder what I can get at the curiosity shop.
I can get something decent at the shop.
I should pop by the curiosity shop when I have the chance.
The right item can make a difference.
May be time to buy a relic.
I should take another look at the store.
No point in saving any more souls.
I can get anything at the store.
I need to spend these souls.
So they got some souls, who cares?
One step closer to summoning the Patron.
The ritual is closer to completion.
Can't help with the ritual. I gotta find the body of some old crone's lover that's buried in Woodlawn.
Lich errands, you know how it is.
I got physics homework to work on.
Can't, my parents are dragging me to some lame party for their law firm.
Helping liches are one thing, but I draw the line at unknowable forces of nature.
I already got through PE once, I'm not running up and down the streets of Manhattan nonstop.
Got work to do at Trinity Church, sorry.
Wish I could help but phylacteries don't just show up on their own.
I think there's safer ways to help my mentor.
The dead make for great sentries.
These guys do a great job at keeping people out of my room.
It pays having a bunch of skulls lying around.
Nothing says 'stay out' like a bunch of floating skulls.
I don't care if it's on the nose it works.
I'm a lot of fun on Halloween.
This was one of the first things my mentor taught me.
Ready to put these guys to work.
I don't get why people don't like it when I use this babysitting, kids love pointing at skulls.
Liches are smart. These guys not so much.
Time for the dead to help me out for a change.
They're not a great conversationalist but they do the job.
Rather this thing get shot at than me.
A corpse can take the bullets for me.
One day, I'll figure out how to keep them around longer, but it’s good enough for now.
Today, I'm calling in all the favors I got from the dead.
The dead are good at rote tasks.
I'm gonna need a helping hand.
I'll have to make my own hallowed ground.
It's a little extreme, but it should slow them down.
Time to build my happy place.
I'll try to hinder them the best I can.
This is gonna be pretty creepy.
The dead can get pretty handsy with the living.
Let the dead grasp at them.
Here's a line they're not gonna wanna cross.
This should make them stop and rethink their choices.
Doesn't get much weirder than a bunch of grasping hands.
I'll do what I can to hold the line.
What's the point of having a lich for a best friend if I can't tap into her power?
I've learned much from my mentors…
There's no escaping what I have planned.
I'll strike them wherever they hide.
Things are gonna get a little weird.
I can't be afraid to do what needs to be done.
I will be one of the greatest necromancers in Manhattan.
Every grave deserves to be marked.
The dead deserve to be recognized.
These streets are haunted by the dead who were never recognized. I'll give them their respect.
There is power in the stillness of the grave.
I'll build my own font of power.
The spirits will come to me.
The dead will strike down my enemies.
The dead will be my shield.
I'm gonna have to call in all my favors with the dead if I wanna stay alive.
My mentor taught me how to stave off death.
One day I'll get a phylactery of my own, but this will have to do for now.
I can't help anyone if I'm dead.
I need to stay in the fight as long as I can.
I won't be joining the dead anytime soon.
I need to face danger head on.
I need to appease my mentor.
I'll take all the help I can get.
I got some friends who would love to say 'hi.'
Cross the line if you dare.
You should never cross the dead.
The dead's wrath will be felt.
I'll find safety in the grave.
The spirits of the dead protect me.
I call on the spirits of the dead.
Ghosts are sturdier than people think.
What's dead will never die again.
I can't give in to fear.
They can try to cast all they want…
Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
I'm not ready for a team fight.
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
And now the Patron gives us our reward.
Look who we're facing, this shouldn't be too hard.
On the plus side if you die we can still keep in touch…
Appreciate you all helping me out, I don't think I could do this alone.
Some of you guys are really big.
We're actually about to do this aren't we…
Hope I did the right thing coming here…
Ready to call on the dead.
Ready to use the lich's blessing.
I'm ready if you guys are.
The dead are ready to obey.
The dead are ready to serve.
Ready to show them what I can do.
